# Speedrun Rules

### **Video Submissions:**

The video must be uploaded as a (Single) Twitch Highlight or YouTube video (Unlisted or Public) and must contain one singular unedited run per submission.

The video must begin while the player(s) are in the Headquarters with the floorplans displayed. If using a manually input seed into the flower pot, Host must be shown entering seed in the recording. (Unless using Speedrun Mod Checker)

In-Game Timer must be turned on.

If playing multiplayer, video must be recorded from the host's point of view.

Host must be on the Steam version of PlateUp!

Host player must show seed settings (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) before run begins or after completion of run. See Seed Categories below for more information and exemptions.

The video must show all gameplay and unobstructed view of all UI elements including: Day indicator (Top Right), In-Game Timer (Top Right), Game Version (Bottom Right), Profile Name Plates (Bottom Middle), Currency/Expected Groups (Top Left), and Day Progress Bar (Top Middle). All must be visible throughout the entire run. Game must be visible at all times.LiveSplit Timer and In-Game Timer must be visible throughout the run.

Map Settings are split into variables on the board. Currently acceptable Map Settings are: Normal (City, Country, Alpine), Autumn, Turbo, Lake, North Pole. Any settings not listed are not valid for speedrunning.

## Seed Categories:

### **Random Seed:**

Layouts can be chosen from the bottom left table, Daily/Weekly map (From Accepted Map Setting List), or manually input into the flower pot.

For random seed, you must have the setting “**Seed Affects Layout Only**” on, found in (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) and must be shown in recording unless using Speedrun Mod Checker (Steam version Only).

### **Set Seed:**

The layout can be the Daily/Weekly map & The Weekly Speedrun (From Accepted Map Setting List), a layout from the bottom left table (with a seed icon only), or a manually input flower pot seed.

For set seed, you must have the setting “**Seed Affects Everything**” on, found in (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) and must be shown in recording unless using Speedrun Mod Checker (Steam version Only).

## Player Count and Allowed Floorplans:

Changes to player count before all customers have spawned is not allowed.

- Solo runs must use a layout with 1 starting table.
- Duo runs must use a layout with 2 starting tables or fewer.
- Trio runs must use a layout with 3 starting tables or fewer.
- Quad runs must use a layout with 4 starting tables or fewer.
- Map settings (such as North Pole), that only have 2 or more starting tables may be used in solo submissions if excess tables are removed from the smallest possible layout.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXexyYY372ER12lSPWmroBQ-9HsB3bYRT5VdG0lsOVMUcs6flwY9h1lQXXUsoxKDmsfIdjZCuElJJ9UIsIotR0cdP_1rZ2fyqMxlbuzvybMGC45AO7RMRgLiaH0vEGMX0TJstC8bcW4FP_mVNNK84iTSMcxh?key=hrvUE-focH_KDRhOl9hEmQ)

Player count is defined as the number of inputs. Additional player characters spawned during the course of a run (Start of Day 1 to End of Day 15) are not allowed.

Any change to player count (including any additional name plate appearance, disconnecting, adding, or removing inputs) during a day before all customers have been called/spawned will require the day to be restarted (returning to lobby, and re-entering the restaurant through the save table.) Player Characters may not be fully spawned in over the Submission Category (1 for Solo, 2 for Duo, 3 for Trio, and 4 for Quad) at any point. The number of participants cannot be higher than the submission category.

The Day Progress bar indicates if all customers have been spawned. Once the bar is full, all customers have been called in/spawned. When taking the card "Closing Time", any change to player count during a day will require the day to be restarted.

## Game Visibility:

Red outlined elements must be visible **at all times:** The recording must show unobstructed view of all UI elements including: Seed/Day indicator (Top Right), Game Version (Bottom Right), Profile Name Plates (Bottom Middle), Currency/Expected Groups (Top Left), and Day Progress Bar (Top Middle).LiveSplit timer, outlined in green, must be **visible at all times,** but can be located anywhere not covering other elements.

Yellow outlined elements must be **mostly visible throughout the recording**.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf5WE5I9w6KfvttucK9solzF-mcuncl86giQNkuikBwCGNidX4PGQ3tvjFBCZRkbX_J4-XmaPklsvwYNDVdBpCi5Yf1LN56gIV1H_ttwCsOi6vZcPgyamY_N0yIxwhiUwuWkSXUfLCc1Ix42cy7Ys2R4Bpb?key=hrvUE-focH_KDRhOl9hEmQ)

## Timing:

The timer starts when Day 1 begins and ends when Day 15 is completed.

Timer does not include the preparation phase before Day 1 only.

LiveSplit integration is required and works only on the host's game.

LiveSplit cannot be altered, paused, or reset throughout the course of the run.

LiveSplit must display timing to the hundredths of a second. (Example: x:xx.xx)

LiveSplit integration Tutorial: https://wiki.plateupgame.com/speedrunning.

## General Rules:

- Items are not allowed to be brought into the run from the Garage.
- If a restaurant does not complete Day 1 for any reason, it may not be restarted and/or replayed. The restaurant must be abandoned and a new restaurant created.

### Twitch Integration:

- The **!visit** option may be enabled.
- !order and !visit trick/treat may **not** be enabled.

## Glitches & Techniques:

As PlateUp! is still being updated regularly, some new glitches may appear and old ones may be patched. Glitches that have been confirmed that will be fixed in upcoming patches are not allowed.

### Known Allowed Glitches/Techniques:

- **Wall Clipping** is allowed. (Dropping an item to force your character through a wall)
- **Wall Clipping into the starting area** is allowed. (Same as above but into an out of bounds area, spawning character in starting position.)
- **“90 Pull”** is allowed. (Removing an item before it’s process complete, but will complete it’s process when picked up)
- **Customers Disappearing** is allowed. (Customers disappearing after being pushed out of their chairs, after being served.)
- **Customers Teleporting** is allowed. (Customers teleporting into their seats.)

### Known Disallowed Glitches:

- **Blueprint Duplication** is generally not allowed, with stipulations below.
- **Cake Bowl Glitch** in 1.2.0, a glitch was added where adding cake batter mixed in a bowl to a tray/pan with at least 1 serving would consume the bowl and batter, while creating a single additional item.
- **Mandarin Orange Prep Station Replenish Glitch** in 1.2.0, a glitch was added where dropping a Mandarin Orange with at least 1 portion missing would replenish the orange to its full portions.

### Blueprint Duplication:

**Random Seed:** May purchase the **top/original** blueprint and rerolls of the **top/original** blueprint The **bottom/second** blueprint and its rerolls must be ignored.

**Set Seed:** May purchase **one** of the duplicated blueprints, **may not reroll that day**.

## Modding (Steam Version Only):

List of allowed mods -[ https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3037523550](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3037523550)

If any mods are used, it is required that you include **“Speedrun Mod Checker”** for ease of verification:[ https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007986429](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007986429)

Use of any mod not currently listed in the allowed mod list will result in a rejected run.

If you would like to suggest a mod be added to the allowed mod list, use this form: [https://forms.gle/gUeJtRxY8CXggXUc9](https://forms.gle/gUeJtRxY8CXggXUc9)

## Patch Rules:

- Submissions will only be accepted for the current leaderboard patch.
- There will be a two week grace period for submitting runs after a patch that forces a new leaderboard to be created, unless otherwise noted.

## Verifying Criteria:

Verifiers will be checking each submitted run to make sure they adhere to all previously mentioned rules.

Videos will be checked specifically for: Visibility of all required elements, Seed Settings, any use of exploits or cheats, and correct information as listed in submission.

For categories that do not adhere to standard LiveSplit integration, verifiers will check the exact time by slowing video at the end of the run to get exact time.

categories.rules:
# Speedrun Challenges

These challenges are offered by the PlateUp! team and planned in collaboration with the volunteer event coordination team in the [PlateUp! Discord](https://discord.com/invite/plateup). We aim to offer one new challenge every month. Speedrun challenges will have a hard cut-off date for submissions to qualify for Discord role rewards, at which point the top three teams on the leaderboard will receive specific role rewards that will last until the next speedrun challenge. Everyone who receives a role reward for a specific speedrun challenge in 2024 will also be given the 2024 Speedrun Challenger role to keep.

# Each challenge has a specific ruleset, however these rules apply to all of them:

- Follow standard Game Rules for video submissions & player count.
- Challenge seed & floorplan is pre-determined by the event coordinators.
- Challenges will be timed based on the In-Game Timer which must be running. Livesplit will not be taken into account.
- No items can be taken from the garage.
- No cheats/hacks or any type of unauthorized software that modifies the game.
- For modded challenges a specific modpack will be provided, only that modpack is to be used.
- Built-in tools like LiveSplit & Chef are allowed, but Chef is allowed for Visits only - no card voting or chat orders allowed.
- Arbitration decisions made by the event coordinators are final and arguing with the event coordinators can lead to escalation, up to and including being banned from participating in future speedrun challenges.

*If a challenge is no longer functioning as intended on a future game version the challenge may be retired.*

These challenges are map-specific challenges, designed by the community to encourage players to adopt speedrunning techniques that align with a specific playstyle or goal.

## All Game Rules will apply unless otherwise stated.

# Turbo Food Card Challenge Rules:

- The map setting must be Turbo.

- Either Random Seed or Set Seed can be selected

- Choose all left food cards. For runs that do not have enough food cards to reach Day 15 (such as Cakes or Coffee), food cards must always be chosen first. - When only customer cards are offered, the player may choose either the left or right customer card.

- No restriction on which Decoration Theme to choose.

- **The following items may not be used**: Flower Pot, Display Stand, Specials Menu, or Specials Terminal. If any of these items are accidentally purchased, they should be left outside of the restaurant so they disappear at the start of the day.

- Any type of tables may be used.

games.name: PlateUp!
games.rules:
# Speedrun Rules

### **Video Submissions:**

The video must be uploaded as a (Single) Twitch Highlight or YouTube video (Unlisted or Public) and must contain one singular unedited run per submission.

The video must begin while the player(s) are in the Headquarters with the floorplans displayed. If using a manually input seed into the flower pot, Host must be shown entering seed in the recording. (Unless using Speedrun Mod Checker)

In-Game Timer must be turned on.

If playing multiplayer, video must be recorded from the host's point of view.

Host must be on the Steam version of PlateUp!

Host player must show seed settings (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) before run begins or after completion of run. See Seed Categories below for more information and exemptions.

The video must show all gameplay and unobstructed view of all UI elements including: Day indicator (Top Right), In-Game Timer (Top Right), Game Version (Bottom Right), Profile Name Plates (Bottom Middle), Currency/Expected Groups (Top Left), and Day Progress Bar (Top Middle). All must be visible throughout the entire run. Game must be visible at all times.LiveSplit Timer and In-Game Timer must be visible throughout the run.

Map Settings are split into variables on the board. Currently acceptable Map Settings are: Normal (City, Country, Alpine), Autumn, Turbo, Lake, North Pole. Any settings not listed are not valid for speedrunning.

## Seed Categories:

### **Random Seed:**

Layouts can be chosen from the bottom left table, Daily/Weekly map (From Accepted Map Setting List), or manually input into the flower pot.

For random seed, you must have the setting “**Seed Affects Layout Only**” on, found in (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) and must be shown in recording unless using Speedrun Mod Checker (Steam version Only).

### **Set Seed:**

The layout can be the Daily/Weekly map & The Weekly Speedrun (From Accepted Map Setting List), a layout from the bottom left table (with a seed icon only), or a manually input flower pot seed.

For set seed, you must have the setting “**Seed Affects Everything**” on, found in (Options -> Game -> Seeded Run) and must be shown in recording unless using Speedrun Mod Checker (Steam version Only).

## Player Count and Allowed Floorplans:

Changes to player count before all customers have spawned is not allowed.

- Solo runs must use a layout with 1 starting table.
- Duo runs must use a layout with 2 starting tables or fewer.
- Trio runs must use a layout with 3 starting tables or fewer.
- Quad runs must use a layout with 4 starting tables or fewer.
- Map settings (such as North Pole), that only have 2 or more starting tables may be used in solo submissions if excess tables are removed from the smallest possible layout.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXexyYY372ER12lSPWmroBQ-9HsB3bYRT5VdG0lsOVMUcs6flwY9h1lQXXUsoxKDmsfIdjZCuElJJ9UIsIotR0cdP_1rZ2fyqMxlbuzvybMGC45AO7RMRgLiaH0vEGMX0TJstC8bcW4FP_mVNNK84iTSMcxh?key=hrvUE-focH_KDRhOl9hEmQ)

Player count is defined as the number of inputs. Additional player characters spawned during the course of a run (Start of Day 1 to End of Day 15) are not allowed.

Any change to player count (including any additional name plate appearance, disconnecting, adding, or removing inputs) during a day before all customers have been called/spawned will require the day to be restarted (returning to lobby, and re-entering the restaurant through the save table.) Player Characters may not be fully spawned in over the Submission Category (1 for Solo, 2 for Duo, 3 for Trio, and 4 for Quad) at any point. The number of participants cannot be higher than the submission category.

The Day Progress bar indicates if all customers have been spawned. Once the bar is full, all customers have been called in/spawned. When taking the card "Closing Time", any change to player count during a day will require the day to be restarted.

## Game Visibility:

Red outlined elements must be visible **at all times:** The recording must show unobstructed view of all UI elements including: Seed/Day indicator (Top Right), Game Version (Bottom Right), Profile Name Plates (Bottom Middle), Currency/Expected Groups (Top Left), and Day Progress Bar (Top Middle).LiveSplit timer, outlined in green, must be **visible at all times,** but can be located anywhere not covering other elements.

Yellow outlined elements must be **mostly visible throughout the recording**.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf5WE5I9w6KfvttucK9solzF-mcuncl86giQNkuikBwCGNidX4PGQ3tvjFBCZRkbX_J4-XmaPklsvwYNDVdBpCi5Yf1LN56gIV1H_ttwCsOi6vZcPgyamY_N0yIxwhiUwuWkSXUfLCc1Ix42cy7Ys2R4Bpb?key=hrvUE-focH_KDRhOl9hEmQ)

## Timing:

The timer starts when Day 1 begins and ends when Day 15 is completed.

Timer does not include the preparation phase before Day 1 only.

LiveSplit integration is required and works only on the host's game.

LiveSplit cannot be altered, paused, or reset throughout the course of the run.

LiveSplit must display timing to the hundredths of a second. (Example: x:xx.xx)

LiveSplit integration Tutorial: https://wiki.plateupgame.com/speedrunning.

## General Rules:

- Items are not allowed to be brought into the run from the Garage.
- If a restaurant does not complete Day 1 for any reason, it may not be restarted and/or replayed. The restaurant must be abandoned and a new restaurant created.

### Twitch Integration:

- The **!visit** option may be enabled.
- !order and !visit trick/treat may **not** be enabled.

## Glitches & Techniques:

As PlateUp! is still being updated regularly, some new glitches may appear and old ones may be patched. Glitches that have been confirmed that will be fixed in upcoming patches are not allowed.

### Known Allowed Glitches/Techniques:

- **Wall Clipping** is allowed. (Dropping an item to force your character through a wall)
- **Wall Clipping into the starting area** is allowed. (Same as above but into an out of bounds area, spawning character in starting position.)
- **“90 Pull”** is allowed. (Removing an item before it’s process complete, but will complete it’s process when picked up)
- **Customers Disappearing** is allowed. (Customers disappearing after being pushed out of their chairs, after being served.)
- **Customers Teleporting** is allowed. (Customers teleporting into their seats.)

### Known Disallowed Glitches:

- **Blueprint Duplication** is generally not allowed, with stipulations below.
- **Cake Bowl Glitch** in 1.2.0, a glitch was added where adding cake batter mixed in a bowl to a tray/pan with at least 1 serving would consume the bowl and batter, while creating a single additional item.
- **Mandarin Orange Prep Station Replenish Glitch** in 1.2.0, a glitch was added where dropping a Mandarin Orange with at least 1 portion missing would replenish the orange to its full portions.

### Blueprint Duplication:

**Random Seed:** May purchase the **top/original** blueprint and rerolls of the **top/original** blueprint The **bottom/second** blueprint and its rerolls must be ignored.

**Set Seed:** May purchase **one** of the duplicated blueprints, **may not reroll that day**.

## Modding (Steam Version Only):

List of allowed mods -[ https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3037523550](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3037523550)

If any mods are used, it is required that you include **“Speedrun Mod Checker”** for ease of verification:[ https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007986429](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007986429)

Use of any mod not currently listed in the allowed mod list will result in a rejected run.

If you would like to suggest a mod be added to the allowed mod list, use this form: [https://forms.gle/gUeJtRxY8CXggXUc9](https://forms.gle/gUeJtRxY8CXggXUc9)

## Patch Rules:

- Submissions will only be accepted for the current leaderboard patch.
- There will be a two week grace period for submitting runs after a patch that forces a new leaderboard to be created, unless otherwise noted.

## Verifying Criteria:

Verifiers will be checking each submitted run to make sure they adhere to all previously mentioned rules.

Videos will be checked specifically for: Visibility of all required elements, Seed Settings, any use of exploits or cheats, and correct information as listed in submission.

For categories that do not adhere to standard LiveSplit integration, verifiers will check the exact time by slowing video at the end of the run to get exact time.
